scope: Read-only host inventory for console font selection; no target execution
kernel_config_extraction: SHA-256-check published Image.gz, gzip-decompress to the AArch64 Image, find embedded IKCFG_ST and following IKCFG_ED markers, gzip-decompress the bytes between them as the kernel's embedded configuration; inspect only relevant lines.
initramfs_inventory_method: SHA-256-check published initramfs.cpio.gz, gzip-stream newc headers and member names without extraction; inspect setfont executable names and standard console font directories.
limitations: The current selected console font was not observed or established by this host inventory.
The argument selects a compiled-in font when fbcon uses the supported kernel option; driver acceptance and actual target font selection are unqualified.
A larger glyph may improve camera legibility, but 720p webcam readability, focus, exposure, and exact failure-marker capture remain unqualified.
Changing fixed boot arguments changes the reviewed launch configuration and requires the normal fresh review and approval path before any physical use.
host_change: Append fbcon=font:TER16x32 to fixed bootargs; existing console, init, panic and all operation bounds unchanged. Bootargs are included in helper configuration digest.

verification.review: Root accepted one production-line change and two existing argv/digest fixture updates.
